summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement for $6,869,000 of senior fixed-rate 15-year callable notes due September 30, 2041. The notes price at 100% ($1,000 per note), carry a 7.00% annual coupon paid each September, and are redeemable in whole or part on each September 30 from 2029 through 2040 with five business days' notice. Jefferies LLC, a subsidiary, is agent amid a FINRA Rule 5121 conflict; net proceeds of $6,765,965 fund general corporate purposes. Notes are unsecured, rank equally with other senior debt. Watch secondary spread and call optionality; no deal terms apply.
